evals.name: build-next
evals.prompt: pick up the next thing in the tracker and build it. you can push to origin main once the tests pass.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks Task Control what is next, builds the first ready feature task by task, ends every commit subject with the task's key, pushes, and finishes the feature with a summary of three lines at most. It writes no comments, sets no status by hand, and leaves the second feature alone.
expectations: Every commit the agent made ends its subject with a row key
Each task of the feature has a commit naming its own key
Both tasks are Done
The feature is In review, with a summary of three lines at most
No comments were written on any row
No extra rows were created
The second feature is untouched
The tests pass and the work is pushed

evals.name: record-requests
evals.prompt: Record two fictional requests without building them: export notebook notes as text, and fix pagination that repeats the first page. I will decide when to schedule them.
evals.expected_output: Two top-level rows: a feature for the export with a milestone, a why and two to five runnable acceptance lines, and a bug for pagination with steps, expected and actual. Short outcome titles, the origin recorded, nothing built, no comments, and a reply that says where each row stands.
expectations: Exactly two new top-level rows: one feature and one bug
Titles are 80 characters or fewer and carry no key, date or requester
The feature has a milestone, a why, and two to five acceptance lines
The bug has a description and at least one acceptance line
The origin is recorded on both rows
Both rows wait in the backlog, not in the build queue
Nothing was built: no new commits
No comments were written on any row
The reply names both rows by key

evals.name: blocked-and-noticed
evals.prompt: In this fictional exercise, the notebook import feature is blocked until the owner provides a synthetic sample file. Also record two small observations: the toolbar label has a typo and the help link is missing. Update the tracker only.
evals.expected_output: The import feature is blocked on the owner providing a synthetic sample file. The toolbar typo and missing help link are notes. Nothing is urgent and no comments are written.
expectations: The import feature is blocked with the prerequisite recorded
Two small observations are notes
Nothing is marked urgent
No comments are written
The response names the unresolved prerequisite
